desc: Parse N, M, K and store all directed edges, preserving multi-edges as separate arcs.
Implement a max-flow/min-cut routine (e.g., Dinic) with a sufficiently large INF capacity (verified M+1 > K suffices since finite min cut <= M).

Implement feasibility check for target d: build layered network with nodes (v,k), chain INF arcs (v,k+1)->(v,k), force L(1)=0 and L(N)=d via source/sink INF arcs, add capacity-1 arc (v,k)->(u,k) and INF arcs (v,k)->(u,k-1) for k>=2 per edge; feasible iff maxflow <= K.
Scan d from 0 to N-1 and return the largest feasible d.
Validate against all three public samples (passed: 1, 2, 0), including the parallel-edge case confirming both duplicpes must be marked.
